class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

def distributeCandy(root):
    def dfs(node):
        if not node:
            return 0, 0
        
        left_excess, left_moves = dfs(node.left)
        right_excess, right_moves = dfs(node.right)
        
        total_excess = node.val + left_excess + right_excess - 1
        total_moves = left_moves + right_moves + abs(left_excess) + abs(right_excess)
        
        return total_excess, total_moves
    
    _, moves = dfs(root)
    return moves
